findings.description: In the affected tag, requestGroupPumpLocked sets pump_scheduled and increments pump_epoch, including on the admission rejection path. enqueuePooledTransfer posts the pump only in the else branch after if(rejected). The fix makes posting independent of rejection.

The affected tag erases an old connection group from state->groups before marking it retiring. The original stale CLOSED-group explanation should not be repeated as established root cause. Later comments identify the dropped pump; their full runtime claims are upstream observations, not our reproduction.

vLLM v0.29.0 receive_kv creates per-worker Tasks and tracks pull_tasks_count per request. process_pulling_result only decrements counts and inserts finished_recving_reqs for ok_reqs; err_reqs is only logged. ERROR and exception paths in receive_kv_from_single_worker record failed_recv and return. This is a source-level terminal-notification gap, not a proof of the full scheduler hang or idle/90-second behavior.

coroperf_opportunity: Observe the exact receiver Task and request/transfer IDs, each expected worker completion, response error, pull counter transition and finished-receive publication; bridge producer transfer/batch and C++ group/pump epoch to these IDs. A Task may finish normally while the request remains unacknowledged; Task stack/birth alone cannot establish request completion.
environment: Three existing Python environments inspected via package metadata only: vLLM 0.3.3, 0.28.0+cpu, 0.27.0. None includes Mooncake transfer-engine. No affected 0.29.0 full PD stack verified. Eight A100 GPUs exist; software prerequisites are the blocker.
